sceneDescription: On a supermarket checkout belt, an oversized, plush gray bath mat sits unrolled with a gleaming gold wristwatch casually resting on one corner. Next to it is a perfectly ripe banana, dwarfed by both the mat and the watch, creating a strange sense of value mix-up. Tucked in the edge of the bath mat is a tiny shopping bag with subtle Modern Retail, TechCrunch, and Jeweller logos, almost lost among the textures. Natural, diffuse lighting makes the scene look like a candid product mix-up, with the absurdity coming from luxury and mundane objects staged as ordinary groceries.
